name: First Step
source:
Valentine's Day is coming soon. The main character suddenly gets asked out by one of her classmates. Not only have they not talked much before this, there seem to be lots of rumors going around about him...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909141325/http://atrandom.whitesnow.jp/g/game/firststep/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
情人节就快到了。主人公突然收到班上一名男同学的约会邀请。两人此前不仅几乎没说过话，关于他似乎还流传着许多传闻…

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140909141325/http://atrandom.whitesnow.jp/g/game/firststep/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
